name: Leo's Key West Campground
note: A small RV-only park on Stock Island: about 48 back-in sites on a mangrove lagoon, plus a few rental campers and apartments. There is no bathhouse, so RVs must be self-contained. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site leoscampground.com read 2026-10-30 (home, pricing sheet 'Effective January 1, 2026', policies, campground map): about 48 back-in gravel full-hookup 30/50-amp RV sites for self-contained RVs up to 42 ft, with standard sites under 30 ft, standard sites of 30-42 ft and premium sites, booked online, by phone or in person. Its RMS Cloud engine (agent 90) sold one night on 2026-11-10 and on 2027-01-12 and 2027-03-16. Google Maps open at the pin with a phone, 4.5/682. No age or class rule, and no homes or lots for sale -> a real transient RV campground. Price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's 'Booking Map' (an aerial photo, drawn with south at the top) and its 'optional waterfront views' on premium sites prompted the audit. Esri World Imagery (sat.py, all frames rendered and read): 1.8 km at 24.5720,-81.7436, 700 m at 24.5705,-81.7430, 300 m at 24.5722,-81.7436 and 150 m at 24.5715,-81.7433. The park's south edge sits on a small enclosed lagoon ringed by mangroves, about 65 x 80 m in its east lobe, with a narrow arm of about 15-20 m running west along the park's sand beach and a fountain cove. In front of the sites is this lagoon, not open bay or ocean: the bay/Hurricane Hole channel is about 300 m west across Cross St, reached by the park's 'mangrove path'. The RV pad by the floating dock (E-37/F-47) sits about 5 m from the east lobe across open sand. The rows on the beach (B-6/B-7/B-7A and those beside the vacation-rental building) sit 15-20 m from the west arm across open, unused sand, with no road, lot or treeline between. Inland rows to the north along Suncrest Rd are not on the water. Pond is earned by the lagoon-edge pads (an enclosed water body this small is a pond, not bay or lake).
fees_source: Operator pricing sheet 'Effective January 1, 2026' (leoscampground.com/pricing, image leos-pricing-2026.jpg), read 2026-10-30. Prices are for 1-2 people before 12.5% tax. Standard (under 30 ft), the cheapest type a 23-ft rig fits: $145 peak (Jan-Mar), $115 shoulder (Apr-May, Oct-Dec) and $75 quiet (Jun-Sep). Standard (over 30 ft) is $160/$130/$90 and Premium is $180/$150/$110. The RMS Cloud engine confirmed the figures on 2026-10-30 for 2 guests and 1 night: Tue 2026-11-10 Standard under 30 ft $115 (excluding $14.38 tax), Tue 2027-01-12 $145, Tue 2027-03-16 $145 (Premium $180). The engine showed no resort or grounds fee.

booking.note: A 2-night minimum, with a 2-night nonrefundable deposit, over Memorial Day, the 4th of July week, Labor Day, Thanksgiving weekend, Fantasy Fest and Dec 20-Jan 1. Bookings for the next calendar year open each April 1, and new guests' bookings for Dec 1-Apr 1 are taken only after April 1, with returning guests given priority.

booking_source: leoscampground.com/policies and the 2026 pricing sheet, read 2026-10-30. The RMS engine sold single nights in January and March 2027.
flags: Cheapest in-season weeknight a 23-ft rig fits: $115 shoulder or $145 peak (Jan-Mar), before 12.5% tax, Standard site under 30 ft. Single nights sell in peak: the engine sold one-night stays on 2027-01-12 and 2027-03-16 (Feb 9 was sold out). The only minimum is 2 nights over holidays.

Monthly stays are sold too (10-30% off, booked by phone), and returning guests get first pick of Dec 1-Apr 1 each year. No count of monthly sites was published, and the engine had 1-3 nightly sites free on each date tested, so the 1-in-10 test passes. There are no homes or lots; the 4 vacation rentals (rental campers and 1-bedroom apartments) belong to the park.

Waterfront is 'pond': a small mangrove-ringed lagoon (about 65 x 80 m, with a 15-20 m arm), not the bay. A 'mangrove path' leads about 300 m west to the Hurricane Hole channel for kayaks. I could not tell from imagery whether the lagoon is tidal or the path is a water trail. Under canopy the call would be creekside at most, never bayfront.

There is no bathhouse, so RVs must be self-contained. Pads hold the RV plus one vehicle, and extra vehicles park on the street. Restricted dog breeds include Pit Bulls, Rottweilers, Dobermans, Chows, Wolf Hybrids and German Shepherds.
RV Life lists this park as 'Leo's Campground' (park 9608), unrated with $$$$ (avg $122).
